lines.t: (Verse 1)
My heart was bound in shadows,
My soul beneath the fall,
But You called my name, Beloved,
And I heard Your tender call.
You said, “Let go, My child, come follow Me,”
So here I stand, upon my knees,
YahuShua, You are all I need,
Take my life, take all of me.
(Chorus)
YahuShua, I surrender all,
All my ways, my rise, my fall.
You conquered death, You conquered sin,
Now let Your Spirit breathe within.
I am Yours — forevermore,
I surrender all, I surrender all.
(Verse 2)
You said, “Do not love this world or its ways,”
For freedom lives in Truth and Grace.
I let go of all I hold,
To find the Treasure of my soul.
You overcame, You broke the chain,
Now only life and love remain.
You gave Your life in place of mine —
Now I live through the Holy Vine.
> “Then YahuShua said to His disciples,
If anyone desires to come after Me,
let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow Me.”
> “Trust in YahuShua with all your heart,
and lean not on your own understanding;
in all your ways acknowledge Him,
and He shall make your paths straight.”
YahuShua, I surrender all,
You are my breath, my heart, my call.
From everlasting, You are HE,
The Great I AM who set me free.
You overcame, You bore it all —
So I surrender… all.
YahuShua, I surrender all,
You are my breath, my heart, my call.
From everlasting, You are HE,
The Great I AM who set me free.
You overcame, You bore it all —
So I surrender… all.
> “My sons and daughters, from the beginning, I AM WHO I AM and shall be.
Even to the end, I AM HE. From everlasting to everlasting, I AM.
In this shall you find rest and know peace, says The Lord YahuShua.
No longer bind yourselves to what you see, nor the things of this world.
Free yourselves by the knowledge that I AM HE.
Beloved ones, I have overcome the world; death is turned backward — only life is and shall be.
Believe, and you shall know. You were made for Me, created for love’s purpose.
This is life: I AM HE.”
(Chorus)
YahuShua, I surrender all,
All my ways, my rise, my fall.
